elements.description:
The sources a knowledge base answers from – ingestion state and progress, documents and chunks, last sync and
schedule, stale and duplicate warnings – with add, resync, pause, remove and a handoff to chunk review.

properties.name: sources
properties.description: The sources. Changed by the user (remove, schedule) unless a tc-sources-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: schedules
properties.default: [ { id: "manual", label: "Manually" }, { id: "hourly", label: "Every hour" }, { id: "daily", label: "Daily" }, { id: "weekly", label: "Weekly" }, ]
properties.description: The sync schedules a source can be set to

properties.name: selected
properties.description: The id of the open source, or null

properties.name: show
properties.description: Which sources show: "all", or "attention" – the failed, stale and duplicate ones

properties.name: now
properties.description: The moment last syncs are counted to, in epoch ms; unset shows their dates

properties.name: noAdd
properties.description: Hides Add source, for a read-only view

properties.name: noReview
properties.description: Hides Review chunks, when the app has no chunk review

properties.name: maxHeight
properties.description: The list's height before it scrolls, in px

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-sources-change
events.description: A source was removed or its schedule changed ({ sources, change: { type, source } }: KnowledgeSourcesChange); cancelable – prevent it to control `sources`

events.name: tc-selected-change
events.description: A source was picked or the open one closed ({ selected, source }: KnowledgeSelectedChange); cancelable

events.name: tc-show-change
events.description: All or Needs attention was picked ({ show }: KnowledgeShowChange); cancelable

events.name: tc-add
events.description: Add source was pressed – open your own picker (no detail)

events.name: tc-resync
events.description: Resync (or Retry, for a failed source) was pressed ({ source }: KnowledgeSourceEvent)

events.name: tc-pause
events.description: Pause or Resume was pressed ({ source, paused }: KnowledgePauseEvent – `paused` is what was asked for)

events.name: tc-review-chunks
events.description: Review chunks was pressed – open your chunk review for the source ({ source }: KnowledgeSourceEvent)

props.name: defaultSources
props.description: The sources on mount when `sources` isn't controlled

props.name: onSourcesChange
props.description: The sources changed: one was removed or its schedule changed

props.name: selected
props.description: The open source's id – controlled when given (null for none)

props.name: onSelectedChange
props.description: A source was picked or the open one closed

props.name: show
props.description: Which sources show – controlled when given

props.name: onShowChange
props.description: All or Needs attention was picked

props.name: onAdd
props.description: Add source was pressed – open your picker; without it there's no Add source button

props.name: onPauseChange
props.description: Pause or Resume was pressed; `paused` is what was asked for

props.name: onReviewChunks
props.description: Review chunks was pressed – open your chunk review; without it there's no Review chunks button
